title: Jamaican Jerk Pork Bake
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-inspired dish featuring slow-cooked pork in a jerk seasoning mixture, served with a crispy baked crust.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together jerk seasoning, brown sugar, and soy sauce.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Coat the pork shoulder with flour, shaking off any excess.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Top the pork with shredded bake and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the pork is cooked through.
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
